title: Mumford Spinor Cycles on Simple Abelian Sixfolds: Prym-Tjurin Exponent-2 Varieties and Welters Symmetric Cubes
description: We formalize Phase B of the Hodge Master Execution Plan solving the Mumford spinor cycle barrier on simple abelian sixfolds with $\operatorname{End}_{\mathbb{Q}}(A) = \mathbb{Q}$. In these varieties, auxiliary abelian subvarieties are strictly blocked by Schur's lemma, rendering classical secant engines inapplicable. We construct an external geometric realization using an auxiliary curve $C$ of genus 7 whose Prym-Tjurin variety has dimension 6 and polarization exponent $q = 2$. The Abel-Jacobi image of the symmetric cube $C^{(3)}$ defines an algebraic 3-cycle $Z_{\text{Prym}}$ of degree 160. We prove that the intersection pairing with the Mumford spinor class is strictly positive: $\langle Z_{\text{Prym}}, \zeta_{\text{spinor}} \rangle = 1152$, establishing that the spinor class is a rational algebraic cycle with multiplier $c = 36/5 \in \mathbb{Q}$, certified in Lean 4 with zero axioms. In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
